title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Health-related Queries with Presuppositions
reasoning: The paper evaluates the factual accuracy and robustness of Large Language Models (LLMs) to presuppositions in health-related queries. It explicitly addresses the potential for 'real-world harm' from inaccurate information and the ethical imperative for models to 'challenge incorrect premises' and provide 'factually accurate information' in 'high-stakes scenarios'. These discussions highlight the ethical implications of LLM deployment in critical domains like health.
